args.title: Juniper Labware — Retail returns logistics summary
args.body:
• Juniper Labware’s latest newsletter highlights retail returns logistics and links to its main article plus a free-registration companion piece.
• The article reports apparel return rates reaching 24%; consolidating returns through dedicated hubs reduced handling costs by 20%.
• The companion piece says reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
